snippet.title: Trigaea - Trailer & Gameplay Video
snippet.description:
Trigaea is an post-apocalyptic sci-fi game about the cost of survival, memories, and being human(e).  It’s text-based, with a mix of storytelling and RPG exploration/combat. [ GAME NOW AVAILABLE: https://ryngm.itch.io/trigaea ]

Game Highlights:

Genetic Upgrade System: Splice yourself with non-human, robot or alien parts to survive the harsh world of Trigaea.
Slay or Subdue: Lethal and non-lethal options for every encounter, even boss fights. Subdue, fight, or talk it out. 
Multiple Gender/Orientation Options: Memories of romance (or friendship) linger with you still. How much have you lost?
200k+ Words: A rich sci-fi story with multiple paths. Unlock memory scenes to learn who you are and what is going on.
Detailed RPG Combat / Survival: Survive as long as you can in a hostile world. Live. Die. Repeat. Unique enemy AI, moves, and resistances. 
12 Endings: Choose the fate of your species. How far would you go to save humanity?

The Story

Today is not your day.

For starters, an hour ago, you woke up in a glass tank. Outside? Rusted ruins, alien creatures and crazy robots. On top of that, the water and food is lethal.

How do you know? You ate something, and promptly died. When you opened your eyes, you were back in the damn tank. In fact, it happens any time you get a fatal bug sting or fall down a hole - (which is entirely too often).

It seems you’re thoroughly unkillable - or, well, they can kill you, but you come back. That's fairly useful, even if it hurts like hell. Seeing the dead copies of yourself outside, though, is a bit demoralizing. 

Someone, somewhere needs to know what is going on. You've just got to survive long enough to find whoever that is...
